about: The alleluia of the formulary “Vigil of Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Alleluia. Give praise to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endures forever.

ex.w005: The adjective is the predicate of an understood subject, the Lord, with the verb left out: “for [He is] good.”
ex.w009: Mercy is the subject of an elliptical clause: “for His mercy [endures] forever.”
